title: Implement Channel Fallback Logic
goal: Define and implement the logic for switching between channels (Voice -> WhatsApp) when interactions fail.

context.rule: IF voice call fails (no answer/busy), THEN wait 15 mins AND send WhatsApp follow-up.
context.constraint: Do not spam. Max 1 fallback attempt per day.

acceptance_criteria: Simulated missed call triggers a scheduled WhatsApp message.
System logs the fallback event in 'interactions' table.
result_summary: Implemented mock event listener for voice failures and created corresponding WhatsApp templates.
